description: The app's TestFlight as App Store Connect has it: tester groups (internal or external, how many testers, the public link and its limit, which builds each has; an internal group may get every build on its own), the beta information Apple's beta review needs (description and feedback email per language) and the beta review contact (the demo password is never shown, only whether one is set), and what is still missing before a build can go to beta review. With buildId (from ploa_release_status or the store's builds), that build's side too: What to Test per language, the groups that have it, its beta review state and its export compliance answer. With groupId, the group's testers and where each stands (invited, accepted, installed).

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_testflight_get
title: Read TestFlight
